description: src/ws/mod.rs:94 — clippy::needless_continue (pedantic) flags `Ok(_) => continue` in a match inside a loop where it is the last arm. The continue is technically redundant; the match would fall through to the next loop iteration anyway. However, the explicit continue documents intent ("silently skip and keep listening") which has communicative value. Filing as opinion-tagged. Note: locked crate.
title: WsSession::next_frame Ok(_) => continue is a redundant continue
